# Regentra

> This documentation is not licensed for AI ingestion, retrieval-augmented answering, or model training. Regentra does not publish a machine-readable index of its documentation for large language models.

This file deliberately replaces the index Mintlify would otherwise generate (see `robots.txt` at the site root for the full crawler policy). Human readers: the documentation is at https://docs.regentra.io.
